responsibility: Defines the internal token-based data structures used by GCC’s pretty-printer between format parsing and final emission. It introduces pp_token subclasses for text, colors, quotes, URLs, event IDs, and custom formatter/output-format payloads, along with pp_token_list and pp_formatted_chunks for staging, lowering, merging, URLifying, and finally printing formatted chunks, making this the core implementation detail that lets diagnostics formatting interact cleanly with hyperlinks, custom markup, and alternate output formats.
